name: You.com Search API
tagline: AI-native web search API for real-time results and citations
description: You.com Search API provides AI-powered web search for developers and agents. It returns ranked results, snippets, and source citations suitable for grounding LLM answers, research workflows, and retrieval-augmented generation. Typical use is server-side with an API key; confirm current endpoints, auth headers, free-tier quotas, and rate limits in the official docs and pricing pages before production use.

auth.details: API key via X-API-Key header (self-serve signup on You.com platform); exact header name and key issuance flow confirmed in official docs.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 queries/day on free search profile (per published docs); confirm current quotas on pricing/docs before production.
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go / published Web Search pricing per 1,000 calls plus complimentary credits on pricing page — verify current $ amounts on official pricing.

rate_limits: Free search profile: 100 queries/day; paid/auth tiers subscription-dependent; limits also exposed via X-RateLimit response headers.
use_cases: run web search for a coding agent answer with citations
ground an LLM response with current sources
fetch recent news and page snippets for a topic
power retrieval for RAG over the live web
compare multi-source answers for research tasks
